description: This file contains the implementation of a quantized tensor requantization function optimized with PSIMD instructions in the QNNPACK backend of PyTorch. The function processes input data, applies scaling, clamping, and converts the results to 8-bit unsigned integers, optimized for precise requantization with SIMD parallelism.

methods.description: Performs precise requantization of int32 input data to 8-bit unsigned integers, using PSIMD instructions for optimized parallel processing. Handles scaling, zero point adjustment, clamping to qmin and qmax, and rounding.
